svg.title: Linux sysadmin and DevOps engineer, half German, half Croatian. I automate infrastructure with Ansible and run it as rootless Podman containers. Privacy-centric, FOSS by default, founder of Who2Industries; if I can self-host it, I will.

g.text: Linux sysadmin and DevOps engineer, half German, half Croatian.
I automate infrastructure with Ansible and run it as rootless Podman containers.
Privacy-centric, FOSS by default, founder of Who2Industries; if I can self-host it, I will.
